raw_text: Forclaz Travel 500 Organizer 40 L Backpack. Price $99.99. Capacity: 40L. Dimensions: 55 x 32 x 27cm. Weight: 1.3 kg. Rain cover included. Format that complies with the cabin luggage requirements of most airlines. Suitcase-style opening. Three inside compartments, one laptop pocket, one water bottle pocket and two outer pockets. Padded straps. Lumbar belt to carry weight on the hips. Fixed back. Ten-year warranty. Coated checked fabric for increased strength. Main fabric: 100% polyester.
